IP
       Namespace IP

DESCRIPTION
       These commands and events are utilized by Local Traffic Manager IP profile. The commands are relevant when there is a rule
       attached to the IP profile that says to raise an event matching a specific tag name and specific optional name and value
       attribute pairs.
